using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

namespace Demo;

public record Point(int X, int Y);
public interface IShape { double Area { get; } }
public readonly record struct Circle(double R) : IShape { public double Area => Math.PI * R * R; }

public static class Program
{
    public static T? FirstOrNull<T>(this IEnumerable<T> xs) where T : class => xs.FirstOrDefault();

    public static async Task<int> Main(string[] args)
    {
        var pts = new List<Point> { new(1, 2), new(3, 4) };
        var q = from p in pts where p.X > 0 select p with { Y = 0 };
        string s = args is [var first, ..] ? first : "none";
        var r = pts[0] switch { { X: > 0 } p => p.X, _ => 0 };
        await Task.Delay(1);
        Console.WriteLine($"{s} {r} {q.Count()}");
        return 0;
    }
}
